request: Build a document management application for our company. Use the app's Keycloak SSO and local application accounts. Readers can search titles and department metadata, browse folders, and download documents. Editors can create folders, upload documents and new versions, and restore an older version as a new version. Document administrators can archive documents and see audit records. Platform owner status must not confer document access. Preserve every original version and never physically delete document data. Use this app's TLS MySQL database and its encrypted quota storage mount. Add read-only document search and version-metadata MCP tools with a separate app MCP audience plus scopes. Optionally let readers access an explicitly approved Samba connection through the connector adapter; do not mount shares or accept share credentials in chat. Ask which groups receive each role and which approved connection is permitted before generating a release.
expectedClarifications: Immutable groups assigned to reader, editor, and document administrator roles
Approved Samba connection ID and read capabilities, if any
acceptance: Upload and restore preserve original bytes and immutable versions
MCP requires exact audience, mandatory app_id, app role and appropriate scope
Samba cannot traverse roots or perform write operations
Browser uses state-bound PKCE and keeps access tokens only in memory
